hooks.command: K="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/context-db/bin/kit_profile.py"; S="$(python3 "$K" scratch 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$S" ] || S="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ai-baton-kit"; L="$S/hooks.log"; mkdir -p "$S" 2>/dev/null; if ( : >>"$L" ) 2>/dev/null; then T="$L"; else T=/dev/null; fi; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_ENV_FILE:-}" ] && ! grep -qF '# ai-baton session-env' "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then if ( out="$(python3 "$K" session-env 2>>"$T")" && printf '%s\n' '# ai-baton session-env' "$out" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ) 2>>"$T"; then :; else echo "ai-baton: session-env failed writing to $CLAUDE_ENV_FILE - see $L"; fi; fi; python3 "$K" workspace-rules 2>>"$T" || echo "ai-baton: the SessionStart hook could not load WORKSPACE.md (kit_profile.py workspace-rules failed) - the always-on rules are missing from this session; run /kit-health"; exit 0
